linkedin.about:
Lewis Howes is a New York Times Bestselling author, lifestyle entrepreneur, high performance business coach and keynote speaker. 

A former professional football player and two-sport All-American, he is a current USA Men’s National Handball Team athlete. 

He hosts a top 100 iTunes ranked podcast, The School of Greatness, which has over 300 million downloads and 1000 episodes since it launched in 2013. 

Lewis was recognized by The White House and President Obama as one of the top 100 entrepreneurs in the country under 30. 

Details Magazine called him one of “5 Internet Guru’s that can Make You Rich.” 

Lewis is a contributing writer for Entrepreneur and has been featured on Ellen, The Today Show, The New York Times, People, Forbes, Inc, Fast Company, ESPN, Sports Illustrated, Men’s Health, and other major media outlets.

Learn more about Lewis at greatness.com

positions.description: Founded in 2013 in Los Angeles, our growing team reaches around the world. What started as a curiosity to interview one mentor for a few people to learn from, has grown to 250+ million downloads, over 5+ million social media followers and hundreds of thousands of students engaged in our books, courses, coaching programs, events and more.

The goal of the School of Greatness is to share inspiring stories from the most brilliant business minds, world class athletes and influential celebrities on the planet; to help you find out what makes great people great.

posts.caption:
USA Champions! 🇺🇸🏆🤾‍♂️

5 months ago I took over @lateamhandball as president and team owner alongside @marthahigareda and it’s been a wild ride! 

Our twin girls were born one month later, and with all the tournaments, health challenges, and business work in between, Martha has been the ultimate champion supporting myself and the team. 

This past weekend we won the title of USA National Champions and it was the first time in 16 years the @lateamhandball won. 

The drought is over, but the journey has just begun. 

We also hosted the final weekend in LA and all the refs, delegates and players from other teams said it was the best run handball tournament in USA in over a decade. 

Thanks to the @greatness team for their event production skills, and commitment to excellence! 

This is one step closer to my dreams at the Olympics and also our investment in building the sport of handball in USA. 

There are many things that must change within USA handball for it to succeed, and we are committed to supporting that mission. 

What a weekend and I couldn’t imagine winning with a better group of people!  Thanks to @mizunohandball for your support all season long and so many other amazing people involved in this championship season!
